title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 301–350 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: We have a flag-raising ceremony every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每週一早上舉行升旗典禮。

examples.en: Monday is the first day of the school week.
examples.zh: 星期一是一週上課日的第一天。

examples.en: I have to submit my math assignment next Monday.
examples.zh: 我下週一必須繳交數學作業。

examples.en: Taco Tuesday is a fun dinner idea.
examples.zh: 星期二吃塔可是個有趣的晚餐點子。

examples.en: We have two consecutive science classes on Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 我們週二上午有連續兩節自然科學課。

examples.en: Our study group will meet at the library next Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們讀書小組下週二下午將在圖書館碰面。

examples.en: Wednesday is the middle of the school week.
examples.zh: 星期三是一週上課日的中間點。

examples.en: School finishes an hour early every Wednesday afternoon in some countries.
examples.zh: 在某些國家，學校每週三下午會提前一小時放學。

examples.en: Can we reschedule our badminton match to Wednesday?
examples.zh: 我們能將羽毛球比賽改期至週三嗎？

examples.en: We will have our science lab on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我們將在星期四進行自然科學實驗課。

examples.en: The school orchestra practices every Thursday after classes.
examples.zh: 學校管弦樂團每週四放學後都會進行團練。

examples.en: Is Thursday convenient for you to discuss the science project?
examples.zh: 星期四方便與你一起討論科學專案嗎？

examples.en: TGIF! Everyone is excited for Friday evening.
examples.zh: 感謝老天週五到了！大家對週五晚上都超期待。

examples.en: We always have our weekly spelling quiz on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我們總是在週五早晨進行每週單字拼字測驗。

examples.en: My classmates and I love watching movies together on Friday night.
examples.zh: 我和同學們喜歡在週五晚上一起看電影。

examples.en: I like to sleep in on Saturday mornings.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在週六早晨睡到自然醒。

examples.en: We took a relaxing family cycling trip along the river on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們週六全家沿著河濱進行了輕鬆愜意的單車旅行。

examples.en: The municipal library is crowded with students on Saturday afternoons.
examples.zh: 市立圖書館在週六下午擠滿了自習的學生。

examples.en: My family usually has a big lunch together on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們全家通常在週日一起吃豐盛午餐。

examples.en: Sunday evening is the best time to organize your schoolbag for the new week.
examples.zh: 週日傍晚是為新的一週整理書包的最佳時間。

examples.en: Stores and restaurants in the night market are bustling on Sunday.
examples.zh: 夜市裡的店家和餐廳在週日熱鬧非凡。

examples.en: Have a great weekend with your friends!
examples.zh: 和朋友度過一個愉快的週末吧！

examples.en: What are your plans for the upcoming three-day weekend?
examples.zh: 你對即將到來的連續三天週末有什麼計畫？

examples.en: We spent the entire weekend hiking in Yangmingshan National Park.
examples.zh: 我們整個週末都在陽明山國家公園健行。

examples.en: January 1st is New Year's Day.
examples.zh: 一月一日是元旦新年。

examples.en: January is typically one of the coldest months of the year in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 一月通常是台灣一年當中最寒冷的月份之一。

examples.en: Many people set inspiring personal goals in early January.
examples.zh: 許多人在一月初為自己訂下激勵人心的目標。

examples.en: Chinese New Year often falls in January or February.
examples.zh: 農曆新年通常落在一月或二月。

examples.en: February is a leap year month when it contains twenty-nine days.
examples.zh: 二月在閏年時會擁有二十九天。

examples.en: Lantern Festival celebrations illuminate towns across Taiwan in February.
examples.zh: 二月份的元宵燈會照亮了全台灣各大城鎮。

examples.en: Cherry blossoms start blooming in March.
examples.zh: 櫻花在三月開始綻放。

examples.en: Soldiers marched steadily in unison across the parade ground.
examples.zh: 士兵們整齊劃一地在閱兵場上大步邁進。

examples.en: Spring officially arrives as temperatures gradually rise in mid-March.
examples.zh: 隨著三月中旬氣溫逐漸回升，春天正式來臨。

examples.en: April Fools' Day is on April 1st.
examples.zh: 愚人節是在四月一日。

examples.en: Spring showers in April bring colorful flowers in May.
examples.zh: 四月的春雨為五月帶來了繽紛的花朵。

examples.en: Students in Taiwan enjoy a joyful spring break in early April.
examples.zh: 台灣的學生在四月初享有歡樂的清明兒童春假。

examples.en: Mother's Day is celebrated on the second Sunday of May.
examples.zh: 母親節在五月的第二個星期日慶祝。

examples.en: May I borrow your English-Chinese dictionary for ten minutes?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的英漢字典十分鐘嗎？

examples.en: White tung blossoms cover the hills like snow across Taiwan in May.
examples.zh: 五月份全台山頭油桐花盛開如雪。

examples.en: The Dragon Boat Festival often takes place in June.
examples.zh: 端午節通常在六月舉行。

examples.en: High school graduation ceremonies are held across the country in June.
examples.zh: 高中畢業典禮於六月在全國各地舉行。

examples.en: The weather turns noticeably hot and sunny as June begins.
examples.zh: 六月伊始，天氣便明顯轉為炎熱且陽光普照。

examples.en: Summer vacation officially begins in July in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣的暑假在七月正式開始。

examples.en: Beaches in Kenting are crowded with enthusiastic tourists in July.
examples.zh: 七月份墾丁的海灘擠滿了熱情的觀光客。

examples.en: Tropical fruits like sweet mangoes and lychees ripen in July.
examples.zh: 像甜芒果和荔枝這樣的熱帶水果在七月熟成。

examples.en: Father's Day is celebrated on August 8th in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣在八月八日慶祝父親節。

examples.en: August is usually the height of typhoon season in the Western Pacific.
examples.zh: 八月通常是西太平洋颱風季的高峰期。

examples.en: We watched the Perseid meteor shower in the clear mountains in mid-August.
examples.zh: 我們在八月中旬前往晴朗山區觀賞英仙座流星雨。

examples.en: The new school semester starts in September.
examples.zh: 新學期在九月開始。

examples.en: Teachers' Day is celebrated with great respect on September 28th.
examples.zh: 教師節在九月二十八日受到隆重慶祝。

examples.en: The autumn breeze brings welcome relief from the heat in late September.
examples.zh: 九月下旬微涼的秋風帶來了消暑的宜人愜意。

examples.en: National Day in Taiwan is on October 10th.
examples.zh: 台灣的雙十國慶在十月十日。

examples.en: Children dress up in fun costumes for Halloween on October 31st.
examples.zh: 孩童們在十月三十一日穿上趣味變裝慶祝萬聖節。

examples.en: The pleasant weather in October makes it the perfect month for travel.
examples.zh: 十月宜人的天氣使其成為最適合旅遊的月份。

examples.en: The weather turns pleasantly cool in November.
examples.zh: 天氣在十一月變得涼爽宜人。

examples.en: Farmers harvest golden sweet rice crops during November.
examples.zh: 農民在十一月收割金黃稻穗。

examples.en: Marathon runners enjoy training in the cool morning air of November.
examples.zh: 馬拉松跑者喜歡在十一月清涼的晨風中訓練。

examples.en: Christmas is celebrated on December 25th.
examples.zh: 聖誕節在十二月二十五日慶祝。

examples.en: Huge crowds gather around Taipei 101 to countdown on December 31st.
examples.zh: 數十萬群眾在十二月三十一日聚集在台北 101 跨年倒數。

examples.en: December is a wonderful time to reflect upon the achievements of the year.
examples.zh: 十二月是回顧與省思這一年收穫的美好時刻。

examples.en: Taiwan has four distinct but mild seasons.
examples.zh: 台灣有四季分明但溫和的氣候。

examples.en: The rainy season usually lasts from May through June.
examples.zh: 梅雨季節通常從五月持續到六月。

examples.en: Football season kicks off with exciting opening matches.
examples.zh: 足球賽季以精彩刺激的開幕戰揭開序幕。

examples.en: Beautiful flowers bloom in warm spring.
examples.zh: 美麗的花朵在溫暖的春天綻放。

examples.en: Natural hot springs in Beitou attract thousands of relaxed visitors.
examples.zh: 北投的天然溫泉吸引了成千上萬前來放鬆的遊客。

examples.en: The curious cat sprang quickly onto the high fence.
examples.zh: 好奇的貓咪敏捷地跳上了高高的圍牆。

examples.en: We love eating mango shaved ice in summer.
examples.zh: 我們在夏天超愛吃芒果刨冰。

examples.en: Cicadas sing loudly in the green trees during long summer days.
examples.zh: 蟬鳴在漫長夏日茂密的綠樹間響亮鳴叫。

examples.en: Our school offers exciting outdoor adventure camps every summer.
examples.zh: 我們學校每年夏天都會舉辦令人興奮的戶外冒險營。

examples.en: Autumn leaves turn golden and red in fall.
examples.zh: 秋天時落葉會變成金黃與紅色。

examples.en: Be careful on the wet hiking trail so you do not slip and fall.
examples.zh: 潮濕的登山步道上請小心行走，以免滑倒摔跤。

examples.en: Apples and pears ripen and fall from branches when autumn arrives.
examples.zh: 秋天到來時，蘋果與梨子在枝頭熟成掉落。

examples.en: Eating hot pot with family is great in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天跟家人一起吃火鍋最棒了。

examples.en: Mountain peaks in central Taiwan occasionally see snow during cold winter days.
examples.zh: 台灣中部的高山山頂在寒冬時節偶爾會降雪。

examples.en: Bears hibernate in warm underground caves throughout the freezing winter.
examples.zh: 熊在嚴寒的冬季期間會躲在溫暖的地洞中冬眠。

examples.en: Taiwan is a beautiful island surrounded by the ocean.
examples.zh: 台灣是一座被海洋環抱的美麗島嶼。

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on our planet.
examples.zh: 太平洋是地球上面積最大且水深最深的海洋。

examples.en: We sailed across the open ocean to observe playful wild dolphins.
examples.zh: 我們航行在遼闊的大海上去觀察活潑的野生海豚。

examples.en: Jade Mountain (Yushan) is the highest peak in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 玉山是台灣第一高峰。

examples.en: We hiked up the mountain trail early to catch the magnificent sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們清晨徒步攀登登山步道，只為捕捉壯麗的日出美景。

examples.en: Fresh mountain air makes hikers feel energetic and healthy.
examples.zh: 清新的高山空氣讓登山客感到精神充沛且身心舒暢。

examples.en: The Keelung River flows through Taipei City.
examples.zh: 基隆河流經台北市。

examples.en: Many people enjoy riding bicycles along the scenic river bank.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡沿著風景秀麗的河岸騎腳踏車。

examples.en: Dragon boats raced fiercely on the calm river during the festival.
examples.zh: 節慶期間，龍舟在平靜的河面上展開激烈競渡。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake is a famous scenic spot in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 日月潭是台灣著名的觀光景點。

examples.en: We rented a paddle boat and glided peacefully across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我們租了一艘腳踏船，在寧靜的湖面上悠閒泛舟。

examples.en: Mist covered the surface of the mountain lake at dawn.
examples.zh: 清晨拂曉時分，薄霧輕籠著高山湖泊的湖面。

examples.en: Banyan trees provide great shade on sunny days.
examples.zh: 榕樹在出太陽的日子提供良好的遮蔭。

examples.en: Planting green trees helps absorb carbon dioxide and cools our cities.
examples.zh: 種植綠樹有助於吸收二氧化碳並為我們的城市降溫。

examples.en: Birds build protective nests among the thick branches of the oak tree.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在橡樹茂密的枝枒間築起遮風避雨的巢穴。

examples.en: She put fresh flowers in the vase.
examples.zh: 她在花瓶裡插上新鮮的花朵。

examples.en: Cherry blossom flowers attract thousands of photography lovers every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天盛開的櫻花都會吸引成千上萬的攝影愛好者。

examples.en: The local flower market sells orchids, roses, and sunflowers.
examples.zh: 在地的花市販售蘭花、玫瑰以及向日葵。

examples.en: Children are playing soccer on the green grass.
examples.zh: 小朋友們正在綠油油的草地上踢足球。

examples.en: We spread out a red picnic blanket on the fresh grass in the park.
examples.zh: 我們在公園清新的草地上鋪開了一條紅色的野餐墊。

examples.en: The morning dew sparkled like tiny diamonds on the grass blades.
examples.zh: 清晨的露珠在草葉上閃爍著猶如細小鑽石般的光芒。

examples.en: The sky turned beautiful orange at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落時天空變成了美麗的橘紅色。

examples.en: Stars sparkled brightly in the clear night sky away from the city.
examples.zh: 遠離城市的喧囂，星星在晴朗的夜空中燦爛閃耀。

examples.en: A colorful rainbow arched gracefully across the blue sky after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，一道色彩斑斕的彩虹在藍天中優雅劃過。

examples.en: We can see lots of bright stars in the country.
examples.zh: 我們在鄉下可以看到許多閃亮的星星。

examples.en: He dreams of becoming an international pop music star.
examples.zh: 他夢想成為一名國際流行音樂巨星。

examples.en: She wished upon a shooting star as it streaked across the dark sky.
examples.zh: 當一顆流星劃過夜空時，她對著流星許下了願望。

examples.en: We enjoy mooncakes and barbecue under the full moon.
examples.zh: 我們在滿月下品嚐月餅並烤肉。

examples.en: The gravitational pull of the moon creates ocean tides on Earth.
examples.zh: 月球的引力在地球上引發了海洋潮汐。

examples.en: The crescent moon shone like a delicate silver boat in the dark night.
examples.zh: 一彎娥眉月在黑夜中宛如一艘精巧的銀色小船。

examples.en: What would you like to eat for dinner?
examples.zh: 你晚餐想吃什麼？

examples.en: What time does the next northbound high-speed train depart?
examples.zh: 下一班北上高鐵什麼時候發車？

examples.en: What a wonderful performance by the school orchestra!
examples.zh: 學校管弦樂團的演出真是太精彩了！

examples.en: Who is that smiling lady in the picture?
examples.zh: 照片中那位微笑的女士是誰？

examples.en: Who won first prize in the national English speech contest?
examples.zh: 誰在全國英語演講比賽中獲得了第一名？

examples.en: Do you know who invented the world wide web?
examples.zh: 你知道是誰發明了全球資訊網嗎？

examples.en: Where can I buy an EasyCard?
examples.zh: 我可以在哪裡買到悠遊卡？

examples.en: Where did you leave your bicycle after school yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天放學後你把腳踏車停在哪裡了？

examples.en: Home is where the heart finds true peace and comfort.
examples.zh: 家是心靈尋得真正平靜與撫慰的所在。

examples.en: When does the English class start?
examples.zh: 英文課什麼時候開始？

examples.en: Call me immediately when you arrive safely at the station.
examples.zh: 當你平安抵達車站時，請立刻打電話給我。

examples.en: I remember the exact moment when we won our first trophy.
examples.zh: 我清楚記得我們贏得第一座獎盃的那一瞬間。

examples.en: Why are you late for school today?
examples.zh: 你今天為什麼上學遲到？

examples.en: The teacher patiently explained why regular review improves exam scores.
examples.zh: 老師耐心地解釋了為何定期複習能提升考試成績。

examples.en: Why not join our cycling club and make new friends?
examples.zh: 何不加入我們的單車社團結交新朋友呢？

examples.en: How do you get to school every day?
examples.zh: 你每天是如何去學校的？

examples.en: How much does a round-trip ticket to Kaohsiung cost?
examples.zh: 前往高雄的來回車票要多少錢？

examples.en: She explained how modern solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
examples.zh: 她解釋了現代太陽能板如何將陽光轉化為電能。

examples.en: Which dessert do you prefer, cake or ice cream?
examples.zh: 蛋糕和冰淇淋，你比較喜歡哪一個甜點？

examples.en: Which platform does our train to Hualien leave from?
examples.zh: 我們去花蓮的火車在第幾月台發車？

examples.en: Tell me which of these two books you enjoyed reading more.
examples.zh: 告訴我這兩本書中你比較喜歡閱讀哪一本。

examples.en: Please stand in line and wait for your turn.
examples.zh: 請排隊站好並等待輪到你。

examples.en: The brave old fortress has stood on the hill for over three centuries.
examples.zh: 這座堅固古老的要塞已在山丘上屹立了超過三個世紀。

examples.en: I cannot stand loud construction noise while trying to study.
examples.zh: 讀書時我實在無法忍受吵雜的施工噪音。

examples.en: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
examples.zh: 請坐下，請放輕鬆。

examples.en: We sat by the window watching the raindrops fall into the garden.
examples.zh: 我們坐在窗邊看著雨滴落在花園裡。

examples.en: Sit up straight during class to prevent back pain and fatigue.
examples.zh: 上課時坐姿端正可以預防背部痠痛與疲勞。

examples.en: The children jumped with joy when they heard the good news.
examples.zh: 小朋友們聽到好消息時高興得跳了起來。

examples.en: You can jump rope for ten minutes to boost your stamina.
examples.zh: 你可以跳繩十分鐘來增強體能耐力。

examples.en: The energetic frog jumped gracefully into the garden pond.
examples.zh: 那隻精力充沛的青蛙撲通一聲優雅地跳進了花園池塘。

examples.en: I will stop by the bakery to buy some bread.
examples.zh: 我會順道去麵包店買些麵包。

examples.en: Can you stop by my office later to pick up the revised schedule?
examples.zh: 你等一下可以順道過來我的辦公室領取修改後的課表嗎？

examples.en: She stopped by her grandparents' house to say hello on her way home.
examples.zh: 她在回家途中順道去了祖父母家打個招呼。

examples.en: Always wash your hands before eating.
examples.zh: 吃東西前務必洗手。

examples.en: Remember to wash your school uniform on the weekend.
examples.zh: 記得週末把你的學校制服洗乾淨。

examples.en: Waves washed gently over the sandy beach as the tide came in.
examples.zh: 隨著潮水上漲，海浪輕柔地拍打著沙灘。

examples.en: Remember to brush your teeth twice a day.
examples.zh: 記得每天刷牙兩次。

examples.en: She brushed her long hair before looking into the mirror.
examples.zh: 她在照鏡子前先梳理了長髮。

examples.en: Dip the paint brush into clean water before switching colors.
examples.zh: 更換顏色前先將水彩筆刷浸入清水中清洗。

examples.en: Let's help clean the classroom after school.
examples.zh: 放學後我們一起幫忙打掃教室吧。

examples.en: Keep your study area clean and organized for better focus.
examples.zh: 保持學習環境整潔有條理有助於提高專注力。

examples.en: Drinking clean boiled water is essential for your body health.
examples.zh: 飲用潔淨的開水對身體健康至關重要。

examples.en: My mother is a wonderful cook.
examples.zh: 我媽媽是一位手藝精湛的廚師。

examples.en: Dad is cooking fragrant fried noodles in the wok for lunch.
examples.zh: 爸爸正在鍋子裡炒香氣四溢的炒麵當作午餐。

examples.en: Learning how to cook simple meals teaches young people independence.
examples.zh: 學習烹煮簡易餐點能培養年輕人的獨立能力。
